rejected_positioning: single image -> diffusion side/back views -> 3DGS -> qualitative render
accepted_positioning: single-image input -> identity-anchored confidence-aware pseudo-view supervision -> full-head 3DGS -> real held-out camera evaluation
core_question: Can 2D hallucinated pseudo multi-view generation become credible 3D Gaussian reconstruction supervision?
no_leakage_rule: No real multi-view images may be used as training supervision for the pseudo-supervision claim; real held-out images/masks are evaluation only.
pass_condition: identity_confidence_pseudo_view improves held-out camera metrics and visual/VLM gates over both direct_single_image and naive_pseudo_view
failure_condition: If the gated pseudo-supervision arm does not improve real held-out camera reconstruction, record a negative answer rather than a qualitative demo claim.
